newsitem.title: USA: Energy Conversion wins cost-cutting funds.
newsitem.headline: Energy Conversion wins cost-cutting funds.

text.p: Energy Conversion Devices Inc and its Ovonic Battery unit said Thursday the United States Advanced Battery Consortium will help fund an $8-million program aimed at reducing the cost of making nickel-metal hydride batteries for electric vehicles.

The 15-month program is a key step as battery production begins at a joint venture between Ovonic and General Motors Corp called GM Ovonic L.L.C. Tests indicate the nickel-hydride battery is the superior power source for electric vehicles, said Energy Conversion Devices.
The company develops alternative energy technologies.
